halves_read: client: forge-gui-mobile/src/forge/adventure (stage, character, data, scene, world, util) and forge/util/Shaders.java

count_basis.classes: hero race/avatar sets in heroes.json (no class stat table)
count_basis.weapons: items matched by weapon name or icon word (approximate)
count_basis.gear_sets: three-piece material sets (body, boots, shield): iron, steel, mithril, gold, dark
count_basis.zones: zone archetypes in points_of_interest.json over 263 typed points

top_creatures.label: Three-Match Sky Warden
top_creatures.why: one of the largest boss silhouettes; flying; three games per encounter plus an intro line make it an event
top_creatures.change: one fight per visit with our own rhythm; our own relic

top_creatures.label: Rimescale Wyrm
top_creatures.why: a big flying dragon with low life; the size promises power and the life total breaks it
top_creatures.change: our own wing and head shape and our own weak point

top_creatures.label: Void Tide Colossus
top_creatures.why: highest life in the data (100) on a flying boss with a relic reward
top_creatures.keep: highest life as a boss tier
top_creatures.change: our own colour and shape; relic becomes an original

top_creatures.label: Hive Anchor
top_creatures.why: a boss that barely moves (speed 1, likely near-stationary); reads as a landmark to approach
top_creatures.change: our own minion spawns while it stands

top_creatures.label: Stoneback Hulk
top_creatures.why: largest scale among boss entries (3.5) on a near-fixed body; a large target to read at 375 wide
top_creatures.keep: large scale on a slow body
top_creatures.change: our own plating and a visible glow on the weak point

top_creatures.label: Brass Sentinel
top_creatures.why: big body (scale 2.5) with low life (25); size and fragility contrast reads at a glance
top_creatures.change: a visible weak point and our own material

top_creatures.label: Splintered Stalker
top_creatures.why: a weakened variant (life 28, no speed value) of a family, showing one sprite family can give several enemies
top_creatures.keep: variant rows that reuse one family
top_creatures.change: our own name, stats and damage cue

top_creatures.label: Pit Marauder
top_creatures.why: mid-tier fiend whose loot shape (probability, count, rarity gate) is the point
top_creatures.keep: per-creature reward rows with rarity gates
top_creatures.change: our own loot table and rarity names

classes: Hero avatars: 16 race/avatar sets with male and female sprite atlases (heroes.json); five are dragon-kin sets; cosmetic, no mechanical role in the data
Colour identity: the deck colours the player brings; enemies carry identity tags (black 160, green 136, red 128, blue 98, white 87 entries)
Faction-like tags on enemies: Territorial 93, Wild 63, Leader 34, Undead 33 (quest code not read)
Progression gate: player rank (wins) sets which creatures can spawn (BiomeData.java:106-109); no talent tree or level table seen
weapon_families: Swords (bronze, steel, flame), axe, bow, sling, dagger, and staffs including one per colour (white, black, blue, red, green)

Weapons carry no damage fields in items.json; effects are card or life bonuses (startBattleWithCard 75, lifeModifier 43, startBattleWithCardInCommandZone 26, moveSpeed 10, changeStartCards 7, cardRewardBonus 3, goldModifier 1, colorView 1 across item effects)
No set-bonus key among the item effect keys
gear_tiers: Material ladder by icon: wood (Wood Bow 1000), bronze (Bronze Sword 2500), iron (Iron Armor 3000, Iron Boots 2000, Iron Shield 6500), steel (Steel Armor 5000, Steel Boots 4500, Steel Shield 6500), mithril (Mithril Armor 15000, Mithril Boots 10000, Mithril Shield 6500), gold (Gold Armor 15000, Gold Boots 10000, Gold Shield 13000); dark set exists
Price does not follow tier cleanly: iron and mithril shields are both 6500; gold shield 13000
Gear slots: body 10, boots 13, neck 25, left 35, right 37 (includes shields), ability1 5, ability2 6; 69 items have no slot
zones: Overworld biomes by colour: white, blue, black, red, green and colourless waste; each with its own music playlist (GameHUD.java updateBGM)
Archetypes (points_of_interest.json): cave 105, dungeon 103, town 25, side-boss moderate 9, side-boss easy 6, castle 6, capital 6, side-boss hard 3
Dungeon maps (names): aerie, barbariancamp, catlair, demontower, djinnpalace, factory, fort, graveyard_crypt, hostiletown, lavaforge, magetower, main_story
Cave maps (names): cave, cave_multilevel 1-3, evilgrove, grove, merfolkpool, nest, skullcave
Dungeon rule effect applied to every duel from a map unless the enemy has ignoreDungeonEffect (MapStage.java:1210-1211; source of the effect not read)
Road tiles (no biome index): no encounters and 1.5x move speed (WorldStage.java:291-292)
Off-road encounter density: one spawn attempt every 4-8 s of walking (WorldStage.java:45, :301); 2.5-5 attempts per 20 s
Biome placement: noise-warped blobs around anchors with overlap by bit mask (World.java:372-412)

looks.label: Foil sheen on rare reward cards
looks.technique: fragment shader: tilt uniform drives streak lines and a hue spread; fixed strength 0.85 mixes the sheen in; low-luminance pixels desaturated first; applied only to loaded foil rewards

looks.label: Rounded card mask
looks.technique: edge test with an edge radius computed from image aspect ratio when the UI mask is Full

looks.label: Particle emitter library (bursts, trails, glows)
looks.technique: separate .p emitter files layered over sprites, so one sprite can take a burst without new frames; CC BY 4.0 for the Particle Park set

looks.label: Encounter contact beat
looks.technique: block sound, haptic pulse (200 ms, 400 ms for boss), freeze, pause for the longer attack animation, mana-burn sound, then a transition made from a screenshot with both avatar names

looks.label: Death beat
looks.technique: death animation with blood effect for 0.5 s, defeat badge dialog, cover-screen transition to spawn point, autosave

looks.label: Boss intro and insult dialog
looks.technique: intro line before a boss duel; insult line on boss loss; strings from the locale file (about 35 intro and 44 insult lines by grep)

looks.label: Scale variation per creature
looks.technique: sprite width and height multiplied by a per-entry scale (0.5 to 3.5 in the data)

looks.label: Minimap player marker
looks.technique: small player icon on the minimap

originals.name: Walk Watch
originals.idea: an encounter director: one creature may appear about every 4-8 s of off-road walking, drawn by weight after a rank gate; it leaves after 20 s or more of walking time
originals.keep: walking-time clock, weighted draw behind a gate, walking-time despawn
originals.change: zone population cap and a grace timer on empty zones (row 23); the ignored-parameter bug is fixed

originals.name: Warden Duel
originals.idea: a best-of-three boss fight with an intro line, a boss music swap and a relic on the last game
originals.keep: three games, intro line, boss music
originals.change: each game server-verified; our own relic; no deck-building dependency

originals.name: Shrine Rules
originals.idea: a dungeon applies one rule change to every duel inside it (extra starting life, faster movement, one card in the command area)
originals.keep: zone as rule data; per-enemy opt-out flag
originals.change: visible rule readout and caps on stacking

originals.name: Glint Card
originals.idea: rare drops show a sheen whose streaks and hue follow a tilt value
originals.keep: tilt-driven streaks and hue spread; sheen only on rare drops
originals.change: our own ember glint; reveal under 0.4 s on phones

originals.name: Six-Metal Ladder
originals.idea: wood, bronze, iron, steel, mithril and gold as gear tiers in three-piece sets; the tier read from the icon
originals.keep: material names as the tier language; three-piece sets
originals.change: prices that rise with tier; our own metals and colours

originals.name: Road Breath
originals.idea: road tiles have no encounters and a speed bonus
originals.change: a visible ribbon with its own ambience bed; speed bonus as zone data

originals.name: Blob Biomes
originals.idea: noise-warped blobs around anchor points decide the biome; a second noise field sets terrain bands
originals.change: one biome per tile with a crossfade band at borders, instead of overlapping bits

originals.name: Hold Still
originals.idea: after a loss the enemy freezes until the player is far enough away, so the player is not re-engaged at once
originals.keep: the hold-still rule after a loss
originals.change: a visible grace indicator and a time limit

originals.name: Contact Beat
originals.idea: encounter start as a short beat: block sound, haptic, pause, then a transition showing both names
originals.change: our own sounds and haptic pattern; threat readout at 375 wide
